title: Optimize a Slow Support Dashboard Without Changing Its Results
goal: Produce `answer/support_dashboard_fix.sql` that updates a seeded helpdesk database with the right query rewrites and indexes so the dashboard workload keeps the same results while avoiding sequential scans and unnecessary heap fetches.
skillBenefitRationale: This task benefits directly from the Supabase Postgres guidance on missing indexes, composite indexes, partial indexes, covering indexes, and EXPLAIN-based diagnosis, which are all needed to choose the minimal high-impact fixes instead of guessing.
